<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many letters of the word **MATHEMATICS** do not have any lines of symmetry?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

A line of symmetry is a line that cuts a shape exactly in half. If you fold along the middle then both halves match exactly.

M, A,  T,  H, and I : If you fold vertically, along the middle of  these alphabets, both halves would match exactly. 

E C : If you fold horizontally along the middle line of these alphabets, both halves would match exactly. 

There is only $1$ letter $S$ in **MATHEMATICS** that do not have any lines of symmetry.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1$

</div>
</div>
